These rating logos are taken unchanged from Seerr v3.5.2 (src/assets/,
https://github.com/seerr-team/seerr, MIT licence), which shows the same
ratings with them. The marks themselves belong to Rotten Tomatoes (Fandango),
IMDb and TMDB.

| File | Shown for |
|---|---|
| rt_fresh.svg / rt_rotten.svg | Rotten Tomatoes critics score (Seerr: rotten when the rating is "Rotten") |
| rt_aud_fresh.svg / rt_aud_rotten.svg | Rotten Tomatoes audience score (rotten when the rating is "Spilled") |
| imdb.svg | IMDb rating (src/assets/services/imdb.svg) |
| tmdb_logo.svg | TMDB user score |
